  Claude in Chrome

  Let Claude use your Chrome browser: open sites, fill forms, take screenshots, and read console
  logs and network requests.

  Status:      ◯ not enabled in this session
  Extension:   ✔ installed
  By default:  ◯ off

  ❯ Manage permissions
    Reconnect extension
    Turn on by default

  ⚠ Claude in Chrome is off in this session, so reconnecting can't add its browser tools. Exit,
    then run claude --chrome (add --resume to continue this session).

  For one session, start with claude --chrome or claude --no-chrome. Claude Code asks before
  Claude acts on a site, unless your permission mode or a rule in /permissions answers for you.

  Learn more: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/chrome
